verdict.rationale: Teller says it lets developers verify ACH details and account ownership instantly for more than 7,000 institutions. It has an account details endpoint, and micro-deposit verification is only a fallback for institutions it can't connect to directly. Live balances are positioned for checking funds before submitting an ACH debit. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the returned account/routing number fields, any tokenized processor-token equivalent, and independent or hands-on corroboration of instant verification.
